title: Hootiefest!
intro: Amy & I were blessed to attend Hootiefest in Riviera Maya Mexico in late January. It was a truly great time!

sections.rightCaption: Leaving Montana, ready for some music and sunshine!

sections.leftCaption: The event was held at the Moon Palace Resort, it was a lovely spot.
sections.rightCaption: A look at one of the many pools lit up for the evening.

sections.leftCaption: The first night was a little rainy, but we didn't mind.
sections.rightCaption: We are ready to hear some great music!

sections.leftCaption: Better Than Ezra, a New Orleans band that I love. They put on a great show.
sections.rightCaption: Hootie & the Blowfish played for three of the four nights, it was awesome.
I didn't know him then, but in July of this year my sister and I met this guy, "VIP Lee." He is SO nice!

sections.leftCaption: Fun times, and more to come!
sections.rightCaption: Enjoying the pool on our first full day at the resort.
